gaps: D&D Beyond does not publish a supported private character-data API for this CLI.
Browser/session-backed live character discovery and dice forwarding remain out of scope.
Image-only PDFs that require OCR are not claimed as supported.
patterns: Beyond20 uses browser access to a live D&D Beyond sheet; this CLI instead accepts user-authorized local snapshots.
D&D Beyond officially supports exporting a character sheet to PDF; a local read-only importer makes that artifact agent-readable without account access.

novel_features.name: Local character snapshot and PDF inspection
novel_features.description: Normalize a user-supplied D&D Beyond or Beyond20 character snapshot or exported PDF.
novel_features.rationale: The printed public-rules surface needs a bounded way to share character-sheet information without claiming a private D&D Beyond API or requiring browser automation.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Agents can read a user's authorized character artifact while keeping account access and mutations out of the CLI.
